faq.heading: Frequently Answered Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about autonomous safety, Meta compliance, and refunds.
faq.q1: What if Shelby makes an aggressive mistake with my ad budget?
faq.a1: Shelby operates within hardcoded, customer-defined guardrails. By default, any budget adjustment exceeding 20% requires your explicit WhatsApp confirmation tap. You maintain complete veto authority at all times.
faq.q2: How long does it take to connect my Meta Ad Account?
faq.a2: Under 90 seconds. You authenticate securely through Meta OAuth via our WhatsApp onboarding link. We request official Ads Management permissions via the official Meta Graph API v20.0. No password sharing ever.
faq.q3: Why WhatsApp instead of a traditional web dashboard?
faq.a3: WhatsApp delivers a 98% open rate and zero login friction. Instead of sitting through two-factor authentication and waiting for 40-megabyte web dashboards to render, you check performance, pause ad sets, and scale winners right from the messaging app you already use every day.
faq.q4: How does the 30-day money-back guarantee work?
faq.a4: Zero friction: simply text “Refund” to Shelby inside WhatsApp within 30 days of subscribing. Our payment processor will issue an instant 100% refund without questions or calls.
